periods.description: A special student combat unit at the Royal Officer Academy with permission to operate Drag-Rides outside normal practical lessons and respond to threats.
periods.history: Created to compensate for New Kingdom Drag-Knight shortages and let talented officer candidates take military tasks under rules.
periods.goals: Train elite student Drag-Knights, defend Crossfield, earn task rewards, and respond first during crises.
periods.structure: Captain Celistia is absent in volume 1; Lisha commands during the large Abyss crisis; members vote on admissions.
